newsitem.title: USA: Avitar signs pact with Trinity Biotech.
newsitem.headline: Avitar signs pact with Trinity Biotech.

text.p: Avitar Inc said Monday it had signed a preliminary agreement with Trinity Biotech Plc of Dublin.
Under the agreement, Trinity will evaluate the performance of Avitar's point-of-care urine drugs of abuse tests against other technologies, it said.
Trinity has agreed not to enter into any agreements with other suppliers of drugs of abuse tests during the 60-day evaluation period, it said.
Avitar, which makes healthcare products, said it will negotiate an agreement for Trinity to sell its drugs of abuse products, including distribution of saliva-based drugs of abuse tests.
Trinity of Dublin, Ireland makes rapid tests for the clinical laboratory, point-of-care and over the counter markets.
